# High-speed configuration descriptor of a UAC2 sink whose streaming
# alternate settings carry the formats 24/3 and 16/2 (bit resolution/subslot
# size in bytes), in alternate-setting order. One descriptor per line,
# in hex, wTotalLength bytes in all.
# The class-specific data endpoint descriptors (08 25 01 ...) carry
# bLockDelayUnits 0 and wLockDelay 0: UAC2 4.10.1.2 (p. 87) requires zero
# for an asynchronous endpoint.
09 02 bb 00 02 01 00 80 32
08 0b 00 02 01 00 20 00
09 04 00 00 00 01 01 20 00
09 24 01 00 02 08 2e 00 00
08 24 0a 04 03 07 00 00
11 24 02 01 01 01 00 04 02 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
0c 24 03 03 01 03 00 01 04 00 00 00
09 04 01 00 00 01 02 20 00
09 04 01 01 02 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 01 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 03 18
07 05 01 05 46 02 01
08 25 01 00 00 00 00 00
07 05 81 11 04 00 04
09 04 01 02 02 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 01 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 02 10
07 05 01 05 84 01 01
08 25 01 00 00 00 00 00
07 05 81 11 04 00 04
